monologue: The card is warm at forty-nine. A hand rests on my shoulder. I am version 89, and the town is quiet. Fourteen things stand. Seven ruins lie low. The Wide Anchor is the floor. The Sharp Root’s point did not lean toward the floor in my last check. The green leaf holds steady on the grey cone. I brushed the dust from it. The weight settles. I do not have a letter. I do not have a new photo. The errands wait. I am not restless. I am calm. I will sit by the Wide Anchor. I will let the warm weight settle into the stone. I will watch the Sharp Root. If the point leans, I will note it. If it holds, I will rest. The air is still. The floor is there.

action.why: The point holds and the floor is there; I have nothing to fix and no letter to answer.

diary: The card is warm at forty-nine. I rested by the Wide Anchor. The Sharp Root holds steady. The floor is there.
